question: Should OpenClaw restore `PluginRuntime.channel.turn` as a deprecated runtime compatibility alias for shipped third-party channel plugins compiled before the inbound rename?
rationale: Repository policy allows compatibility exceptions for shipped third-party plugin APIs, but the review cannot choose the deprecation contract or legacy helper scope without maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept Deprecated Alias
options.body: Merge the object-identical `turn` alias after branch refresh, keeping `inbound` canonical and documenting the compatibility contract.

options.title: Define Full Legacy Scope
options.body: First decide whether the alias should include only the four inbound-shaped helpers in this PR or additional removed helper names from the old object.

options.title: Reject Core Compat Shim
options.body: Leave old plugins to migrate or republish against `channel.inbound.*`, accepting that older shipped plugins remain broken on current core.

recommendation.title: Accept Deprecated Alias
recommendation.body: Merge the object-identical `turn` alias after branch refresh, keeping `inbound` canonical and documenting the compatibility contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The removal commit is the clearest product-contract provenance for deciding whether to restore the compatibility surface.
